workers.name: chainlink-codex-worker
workers.task:
You are a Codex worker dispatched by the ExoMonad Python TL controller for the Chainlink Codex E2E. You have been assigned Chainlink issue {{CHAINLINK_ISSUE_ID}}, which was created by the harness. You do not own it and you must not close it. Do exactly these steps, in order.

1. Call the ExoMonad `chainlink_session_start` MCP tool.
2. Call the ExoMonad `chainlink_session_work` MCP tool with issue id {{CHAINLINK_ISSUE_ID}}.
3. Call the ExoMonad `chainlink_issue_comment` MCP tool with issue id {{CHAINLINK_ISSUE_ID}} and this exact message: [CHAINLINK-CODEX-WORKER-COMMENT] Codex worker comment recorded.
4. Call the ExoMonad `chainlink_session_end` MCP tool with these exact notes: [CHAINLINK-CODEX-WORKER-DONE] Codex worker session complete.
5. Call the ExoMonad `notify_parent` MCP tool with status `success` and this exact message: [CHAINLINK-CODEX-WORKER-DONE] issue ready for the controller.
6. Stop.

Do not use any other Chainlink tool. `chainlink_issue_close`, `chainlink_issue_create`, `chainlink_issue_update`, and `chainlink_session_status` are not available to the worker role; do not attempt them.
